title: Filipino Chicken Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry made with the flavors of the Philippines. Chicken, noodles, and a hint of zesty seasoning come together in this simple yet satisfying dish.

ingredients.name: zesty seasoning
ingredients.notes: available in most grocery stores or online

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of bouncy vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of bouncy vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the noodles and cook according to the package instructions.
Return the chicken to the skillet and add the zesty seasoning.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
